sentences.text: If you put snacks in a box with a coin slot, you have a vending machine.
But people just reach in and take them for free.
So you lock them behind glass, each snack sitting in a spiral coil.
Drop in a coin, and a little motor turns the coil one full turn.
But sometimes the snack gets stuck on the edge.
So an invisible light beam watches the bin, and if nothing falls through it, the spiral turns again.
Japan has over 2 million drink machines, about one for every 55 people.
And the vending machine is not a modern idea.
Hero of Alexandria built one 2,000 years ago that poured holy water for a coin.
Add a cooler underneath and a light on top.
Congratulations, you have built a vending machine.

facts.claim: Many machines use an infrared drop sensor: if no product falls through the beam, the coil turns again, and the money is refunded if it still fails
